name: The Twins (Sapling/Good Mind and Flint/Bad Mind)

domain_history.domain: paired complementary cosmological forces (day/night, summer/winter, life/death, straight-mind/crooked-mind) born of Sky Woman's daughter; shape the world in rivalry

notes: Commonly rendered Sapling (also Good Mind, Right-Handed, or Teharonghyawago/"Holder of Heaven") and Flint (also Bad Mind, Left-Handed, Mohawk Tawiskaron). A strict "good vs. evil" moral-binary reading of the twins is flagged across multiple secondary sources as showing likely Christian missionary overlay (some recorded 19th/20th-century versions include apparent virgin-birth imagery); in less-Christianized tellings the twins are paired complementary forces rather than a Manichean struggle, with Flint functioning as a trickster figure in a rivalry, not a devil-figure. Exact name-to-nation mapping should be checked against Hewitt (1903/1928) directly before further refinement, per the research agent's own flag — tertiary compilations disagreed somewhat on this point.
